paper.title_en: The dual Ginzburg-Landau theory for a holographic superfluid/superconductor: Critical dynamics
paper.abstract_en: Holographic superfluids/superconductors are one of the most studied systems in the AdS/CFT duality. In the low-energy, in the long-wavelength limit, they should be described by a Ginzburg-Landau theory. For critical dynamics, one expects that they belong to "model F" universality class. We consider a bulk 5-dimensional holographic superfluid/superconductor in the probe limit. For the holographic superconductor, we impose the boundary Maxwell equation to make the boundary Maxwell field dynamical. We identify the dual model F equations where numerical coefficients are obtained exactly.

decision.title_zh: 全息超流体/超导体的对偶金兹堡-朗道理论：临界动力学
decision.abstract_zh: 全息超流体/超导体是AdS/CFT对偶中研究最多的系统之一。在低能、长波长极限下，它们应该由金兹堡-朗道理论描述。对于临界动力学，人们预期它们属于“模型F”普适类。我们考虑探针极限下的5维体全息超流体/超导体。对于全息超导体，我们施加边界麦克斯韦方程以使边界麦克斯韦场成为动力学场。我们识别出对偶的模型F方程，其中数值系数精确获得。
